infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Elovia uses the camera to scan food items and log your meals with AI food recognition.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Elovia needs access to your photos to let you select food images for AI meal logging.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Elovia uses your location to track runs and outdoor workouts in real time.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Elovia reads your steps, workouts, sleep, and heart data so your dashboard and AI plans reflect what you actually did.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Elovia saves the workouts and runs you complete to Apple Health so they appear alongside your other activity.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Elovia uses motion data to count your daily steps.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Elovia uses your location during a run when the screen is locked and, if you enable saved places, to detect when you arrive at your gym. You can turn this off at any time.
